rules.title: Broker fee paid only by the party who hired the broker (c.112 s.87DDD1/2)
rules.requirement: A licensed broker may contract only with the tenant or only with the landlord, and any fee is paid only by the party who hired the broker, so landlord-hired brokers cannot charge the tenant.
rules.key_value: Broker fee paid only by the party who engaged the broker
rules.coverage_conditions: Licensed brokers or salespersons finding rental housing for a fee
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
rules.interaction: Statewide; text confirms effective 2025-08-01 (2025, c.9, s.43).

notes: Effective date verified in text header: effective August 1, 2025.
